notes: PROPOSAL only, not enqueued. Inventory identified 6 signal categories, 6 MCP exposure gaps, and 7 recommended neural priority target fields. Follow-up tasks below are ordered by priority (P0->P1->P2).

follow_up_tasks.goal: Add a new MCP tool geoai_task_review_compact that returns only the P0 neural priority fields (risk_level, change_scope, collision_risk) plus task_id, topic, runner, and status for every review-queue task in a single compact response. No mutation, no card_json dump.
acceptance: new MCP tool returns <=5 fields per task for the full review queue
no card_json included; no write-gate change

follow_up_tasks.goal: Add per-task validation-result storage so taskctl review can record test pass/fail, and MCP can expose validation_gate per task. Currently verify is queue-wide only.
acceptance: taskdb schema extended with validation_result column or events table row

follow_up_tasks.goal: Join usage_report token/cost data into geoai_task_show and geoai_task_review_compact so cost signals are available without a separate MCP call.
acceptance: geoai_task_show response includes input_tokens, output_tokens, cost_usd when usage exists
no new DB table; joins from existing usage_events

follow_up_tasks.goal: Train a shadow neural priority ranker on the B160 inventory fields and measure ranking agreement with Codex review order on historical finished tasks. Uses the P0-P2 target fields from this inventory.
acceptance: ranking agreement measured against Codex actual review order
P0 fields alone achieve >=0.7 rank correlation
no runtime authority; shadow-only with abstain label

follow_up_tasks.goal: Add staleness_tier signal computed from age_hours and review_wait_hours percentiles, exposed in geoai_task_review_compact for automated staleness flagging.
acceptance: staleness_tier enum: fresh(<24h), normal(24h-7d), aging(7d-30d), stale(>30d)
computed from actual timestamps at query time
